lead_order_basis: three ECG100C channels sorted by source channel index; anatomical labels require source metadata confirmation
resampling: scipy.signal.resample_poly with Kaiser beta 8.6 and line padding; no missing-value fill
spatial_derivative: central numerical gradient with seconds as the coordinate
edge_policy: zero_phase_filter_on_complete_group_window; candidates within 10 seconds of the window edges are retained only as candidate annotations
missing_policy: reject nonfinite group windows; no interpolation or gap bridging
output: candidate peaks and per-lead local refinements; human review required; no NN-HRV claim
